_meta.source: Hand-maintained. Single source of truth for Build Room events. After ANY edit run: node scripts/sync-events.js (syncs Google Calendar 'The Build Room Events Calendar', GitHub Pages mirror at alexsalinsky.github.io/build-room-visuals/events.json, and the EC2 plan pages).
_meta.structure: events = public-audience events only (retreats, build labs, conferences, kickoffs). NO cohort sessions — those live in the Drafting Table config as a starting week. work = internal milestones/deadlines around an event, each linked via parentEvent.
